WHAT IS PROVED (all kernel-checked, no fake object, no added hypothesis):
1. S1832TwoPullback f g for a cospan of ACTUAL cover maps f : A->C, g : B->C: apex cover, toA/toB cover maps, 2-commutator, lift of every pseudo-cone, liftToA/liftToB, uniq up to 2-iso. Strength = exactly a limit of the cospan in the 2-iso quotient (see 3), strictly stronger than the 7-field EtalePseudofunctorSquare.TwoPullbackWitness (S1801/S1827).
2. QUOTIENT UNIVERSAL PROPERTY IS FREE: S1832PullbackConeIsLimit / S1832HasLimit_of_twoPullback / S1832HasPullback_of_twoPullback turn any such bicategorical datum into a genuine Mathlib limit (PullbackCone + IsLimit) in S1728ActualCategory11, using Quot.out and S1809EqvGen_to_rel for the class-vs-2-iso bookkeeping. This answers S1762's remark that "the quotient universal-property half is also missing": it is provably automatic.
   => S1832HasPullbacks_of_squares : (forall cospans, Nonempty S1832TwoPullback) -> HasPullbacks S1728ActualCategory11
   => S1832PullbackObligationActual_of_squares : ... -> S1762PullbackObligationActual
3. CONVERSE: S1832TwoPullbackOfHasPullback : HasPullback (class f) (class g) -> S1832TwoPullback f g.
   => S1832FirstMissing_iff_hasPullbacks : S1832FirstMissingPullback <-> @HasPullbacks S1728Cover S1728ActualCategory11
   => S1832FirstMissing_iff_S1762 : S1832FirstMissingPullback <-> S1762PullbackObligationActual.
   So the PRECISE FIRST MISSING is exactly: for every cospan of actual cover maps, a finite-etale cover apex carrying that bicategorical pullback datum. Any future inhabitant of S1832FirstMissingPullback fills S1762's pullback field with no extra quotient work.
4. UNCONDITIONAL INSTANCES (non-vacuousness, uses S1641 identity cover map + S1728 unitors, i.e. the S1762 identity/terminal API): S1832TwoPullback_id_right (cospan (f, S1641CoverMapId)), S1832TwoPullback_id_left, and actual S1832HasPullback_id_right / _left in the quotient category.
5. CONSUMERS: S1832HasFiniteLimitsActual : S1832FirstMissingPullback -> S1736ObligationFiniteLimits (via S1762HasFiniteLimits_of_pullbacks, terminal already closed by S1762); S1832PreGaloisCategoryOfSquares : S1832FirstMissingPullback + S1762's three remaining fields -> S1736ActualPreGaloisObligation.

HONEST LIMITS / WHAT REMAINS:
* No inhabitant of S1832FirstMissingPullback or HasPullbacks is asserted.
* Not constructed: the iso-comma/pseudopullback stack as a category-valued pseudofunctor with its IsStack (descent) proof; a structure map from it to X.stack with a representably-finite-etale proof (needs base-change presentations of the two projections + stability of finite etaleness under pullback/composition; note OrbicurveFiniteEtaleCoverMap carries NO finite-etale field, so even "a map between finite-etale covers is finite etale" is unavailable); the strong-transformation-level universal property.
* NOT formalised: transport of HasPullbacks from S1728ActualCategory11 to the equivalent S1809CoverCategory01 (S1809ComparisonFunctor_isEquivalence). Same geometric input would be the only gap there.
* Did not touch shared state: coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md, AUDIT_LEDGER.md unchanged (please record). Only added the S1832 lean file, throwaway probes _S1832Probe*.lean/_S1832ConsumerCheck.lean and logs under tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/logs/.

SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: the remaining work is geometric, not categorical: construct the pseudopullback stack of A.source -> C.source <- B.source with IsStack, and prove its structure map to X.stack representably finite etale (equivalently, via cover-source representability S1756SourceRepresentableAll + scheme-level fiber-product finite etaleness). Categorically nothing further is needed: S1832FirstMissing_iff_S1762 closes the gap the moment that object exists.
